info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Loan Applications API
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to update existing loan applications efficiently. It serves to modify the details of a specified loan application identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include financial institutions and loan processing systems that need to manage loan application data effectively. By utilizing this API, users can ensure that loan application information is accurate and up-to-date, facilitating better decision-making in the lending process.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific loan application identified by its unique reference number. Ensure that you provide all required fields in the request body to successfully update the loan application.

requestBody.description: The request body must include the necessary information to update the loan application with ID RES-100045. This information typically includes details like the applicant's updated financial situation, loan amount requested, and any changes in personal information or circumstances.
